subtitle: The architect still owns the trade-offs

sections.heading: Ask
sections.body: Get multiple stack options from the coding agent.

sections.heading: Decide
sections.body: Pick a stack you can read, review, debug, and maintain.

sections.heading: Own
sections.body: Hosting, APIs, jobs, and operational complexity remain human decisions.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: The agent helps with architecture. It does not own architecture.
